title: Valentias Entropy
description: A mod focused on expanding minecraft main progression
body:
Valentias Entropy is my biggest project for now, this mods adds a lot of content with a whole new progression with its unique materials and mechanics.

This mod adds New Mobs, New Materials/Ores and new Crafting Tables

This mods add a lot of new ore tiers and weapons which you can use through your world

This mod is focused in adding new content through a normal vanilla world and adding more content post-enderdragon


--THIS IS IMPORTANT--

Due to some problems in this mod the world generation has changed.

Now from Y-42 to Y-64 all the deepslate has been replace with a new stone called Core Stone

(This can cause problems with other mods ore generation but you can still play with them and If you dont have any optimization mod this may cause some lag when first generating the world)

 

In case you found any bug or you have any suggestions please join my discord server <3
